BAIL APPLN. 3151/2023 was filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No 67/2023 dated 09.02.2023 under Sections 420/34 IPC registered at PS: Chhawla.

2. BAIL APPLN. 3154/2023 was filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No 67/2023 dated 09.02.2023 under Sections 420/34 IPC registered at PS: Chhawla.

3. After canvassing some arguments, learned counsel for the applicants, on instructions, seeks to withdraw these applications with liberty to take recourse to appropriate remedies at appropriate stage before the Trial Court.
4. Applications are disposed of as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for, in accordance with law.
